content: 1. Once you create a username on WikiDoc, you will automatically have a User Page assigned to you. 2. On your User Page, you are encouraged to provide information about yourself, including your medical qualifications. 3. It is recommended that you include a concise biography detailing your medical training, academic degrees, area of specialty, research interests, or any other relevant information you wish to share with the community. 4. However, you must not post sensitive information such as your DEA number, medical license number, or any other private details. 5. You can also learn how to upload and insert your picture on this page. 6. Keep in mind that this page is publicly accessible, meaning that patients or colleagues may view it if they search for your name on Google. 7. WikiDoc also provides a Physician Space Page, which serves as an example of how you can structure your professional profile. 8. To edit your User Page, simply click on your username located at the top of the page and make the desired changes. 9. Every registered user is provided with a Discussion Page, also referred to as a Talk Page. 10. To access your Discussion Page, click on the red Discussion tab located at the top of your User Page. 11. You can use this page to leave messages for other users on their respective Discussion Pages. 12. It is advisable to periodically check your own Discussion Page by clicking on the My Talk link next to your username at the top of the screen. 13. This is where other members of the WikiDoc community may leave messages or communicate with you.
